scope: Full static review of directory settings and preview helpers, plus App edit/preview/save/export integration; not complete App or actual browser acceptance
review_notes: Clearing a field removes its project override; protected local sources are explicitly labeled.
Preview validates complete absolute root bindings, provenance labels and read-only response status; timeout and failures remain errors.
App edits invalidate preview generations; late results cannot replace newer drafts. Saving previews the exact snapshot and applies conflict checks before conditional server save.
Export waits for saving and rejects recipe changes during save; directory preview does not move media.
remaining: Complete custom directory real product matrix
